about_h2: Technical training, keen ear for atmosphere
about_bio_p1: I trained professionally at the Inted Music School in Madrid, refining my technique and developing a clear criterion for crafting a set.
about_bio_p2: My sound revolves around House and its most vibrant, uplifting subgenres: from the groove of Funky House and Tech House, to the organic atmosphere of Afro House, Latin Afro, and Nu Disco.
about_bio_p3: I approach every set as a progression: starting by setting the mood for afternoon conversation and gradually building the energy until staying seated is no longer an option.
about_bio_p4: Thinking about a date? Tell me the details of your event and let's make it happen.
